text:
I'm very unimpressed. I had a filling done, but the dentist didn't clean out all the decay before filling it. After a while, my tooth started hurting.
So I went for an x-ray at a new clinic, and they found that the remaining decay had spread down to the root, causing root inflammation.
I need root canal treatment, which will cost tens of thousands of baht, and a crown, which will also cost tens of thousands of baht.

Dr. Bird is so lovely!
She's very skilled and has a wonderful personality. I always follow Dr. Bird wherever she goes. My whole family gets our dental work done by her.

text: I went to inquire about wisdom tooth extraction, and the clinic (at the counter) quoted me this much. What really upset me was that before they even looked at my tooth, they said it was crooked, difficult to extract, and that the price would definitely be this much. Seriously, they were incredibly incompetent.
